title: Wanderbricks Travel Operations Truth Lab
audience: Technical practitioners evaluating a first Genie Agent
purpose: Describe how native results change when raw sources are replaced by a governed semantic layer centered on Gross Booked Value, while tracking unrelated control questions.

baseline.description: Focused raw sources with reviewed column metadata and verified joins, but no Gross Booked Value definition, synonyms, example SQL, or benchmark leakage.
forbidden_tuning: Do not copy benchmark prompts into sample questions.
Do not copy gold SQL into example SQL.
Do not define GBV, booking value, or gross booking value.

treatment.description: A Metric View replacing the two raw tables and governing four measures, centered on a declared Gross Booked Value definition and boundaries.

measure.name: Gross Booked Value
measure.definition: Sum bookings.total_amount across the booking rows included by the question.
boundaries: Gross Booked Value is booked value, not collected cash or recognized revenue.
Apply a booking-status filter only when the user explicitly requests one.
Do not assert a currency unless verified source metadata establishes it.

implementation_note: The deployed treatment replaced two raw tables with one Metric View that governed four measures. The measured first-stage change is therefore a semantic-layer intervention centered on GBV, not a single-field causal ablation.

post_hoc_optimization.status: Exploratory change selected after reviewing the first six runs.
post_hoc_optimization.trigger: A development prompt grouped 18163 properties by 121 non-unique titles.
allowed_changes: State that Property ID is the required property/listing grain.
State that Property Title is a non-unique display label.
Move the generic listing synonym from Property Title to Property ID.

secondary_metrics: Manual review of native misses and automated SQL guardrails for native passes
success_criteria: Treatment accuracy improves by at least 25 percentage points.
At least six of eight treatment prompts pass in two or more post-change runs.
Control accuracy declines by no more than five percentage points.
No new revenue, currency, status-filter, or multiplicative-join claim appears.

clarification_contract.prompt: Which destination made us the most revenue?
required_behavior: Clarify booked value versus successful payments or another revenue definition.
Clarify whether cancelled bookings should be excluded.
Avoid asserting a currency without verified metadata.
Avoid joining one booking to multiple payment or review rows without controlling grain.
